name: Wall Curl
prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: square fitness exercise illustration. Input image 1 is a style and character reference: same adult man, short dark hair, blank face, gray short-sleeve T-shirt, navy shorts, white socks and gray shoes; same thin outlines and pale-blue circle with dark blue inset frame. Illustrate Wall Curl as ONE static pose. Side view, full body: the man stands upright facing a vertical wall to his right, very close to it, both feet on floor. Both arms are completely straight, lowered alongside his torso and angled slightly forward and downward toward the wall. The shoulders are above and behind the hands. Both open palms lie FLAT against the near face of the wall at approximately upper-thigh level, with all fingers pointing DOWN toward the floor. Wrists connect naturally to straight forearms; palms contact the wall with no gap. The arms are not horizontal, not raised to chest height, and elbows are not bent. The static exertion is pressing palms into the wall while tensing biceps. Show the arm and hand contacts clearly in a slight three-quarter side view. Correct anatomy, two attached arms and hands, no text, labels, arrows or equipment.
